Free printable reading kits

Three one-click PDFs for readers, teachers and book clubs. Free to print, copy and share with your group; please link back to this page if you share them online.

TL;DR
  • Monthly reading tracker: log books, minutes and one takeaway each.
  • Book club starter kit: club card, roles, first-meeting agenda, discussion questions.
  • 52 books in 2027: one page, 52 lines, monthly themes.

Monthly reading tracker

A one-page log for a month: title, author, format, minutes, finished date and one takeaway per book, plus a 31-day habit strip.

Book club starter kit

How to use them

  • Print on A4 or US Letter (the PDFs fit both with standard margins), or fill them in on a tablet.
  • Keep the tracker next to your bed or in the book you're reading, so logging takes ten seconds.
  • For clubs, print the starter kit before the first meeting and fill in the club card together.

Questions people ask

Can I share these printables with my class or book club?

Yes. You can print, copy and share them with your students, club or colleagues for free. If you share them on a website or social media, please link to this page rather than uploading the files elsewhere, so people always get the latest version.

Are the printables really free?

Yes. There is no sign-up and no email required; click the link and the PDF opens. They are made by Intellect AI, the free guide site by the team behind Zehn, and include a small footer with the site address. There are no ads in the files.

Can I edit the PDFs?

The PDFs are designed to be printed and filled in by hand or with a PDF app on a tablet. If you need a custom version for a school or club, such as your own logo or questions, write to contact@safarigrp.com and we will see what we can do.
